lines.zh: 高雄仁武，田野與街巷之間，有一群人默默行善。
lines.en: In Renwu, Kaohsiung, among fields and lanes, people quietly do good.

lines.zh: 他們相信：人溺己溺，人飢己飢。
lines.en: They believe another's hardship is their own.

lines.zh: 這是高雄市堅山慈善會的故事。
lines.en: This is the story of the Kaohsiung Jianshan Charity Association.

lines.zh: 民國八十五年九月，七位鄉親發起慈善籌備會。
lines.en: In September 1996, seven neighbours formed a charity preparatory group.

lines.zh: 八十六年元旦，堅山南邑慈善會正式運作。
lines.en: On New Year's Day 1997, the Jianshan Nanyi Charity Association began work.

lines.zh: 首任會長李慶瑞，把自家住所借作會址。
lines.en: Its first president, Li Ching-jui, lent his own home as its office.

lines.zh: 會員很快破百，八十七年遷到林山巷新會址。
lines.en: Members soon passed 100, and in 1998 it moved to Linshan Lane.

lines.zh: 會館另外募款興建，從不動用慈善基金。
lines.en: The hall was built with separate donations, never touching charity funds.

lines.zh: 九十年正式立案，黃金城當選首屆理事長。
lines.en: Registered in 2001, it elected Huang Chin-cheng as first chairman.

lines.zh: 九十二年成立顧問團，陪伴會務一路向前。
lines.en: In 2003 an advisory group was formed to support its work.

lines.zh: 陳國泰四度出任理事長，會員成長到九百多人。
lines.en: Chen Kuo-tai served four terms as chairman; members grew past 900.

lines.zh: 一百零一年，大家終於搬進自己的會館。
lines.en: In 2012, members finally moved into a hall of their own.

lines.zh: 洪丰裕、沈玉文到李國忠，一棒接一棒傳承。
lines.en: From Hung Feng-yu and Shen Yu-wen to Li Kuo-chung, the torch passed on.

lines.zh: 急難救助是堅山的核心，理監事每月輪流訪視。
lines.en: Emergency relief is its core; board members take turns visiting each month.

lines.zh: 前理事長陳國泰與夫人吳惠豐，至今仍親自訪視。
lines.en: Former chairman Chen and his wife Wu Hui-feng still visit in person.

lines.zh: 一一二年，協助高雄、台南、屏東急難個案八十八件。
lines.en: In 2023, it helped 88 emergency cases in Kaohsiung, Tainan and Pingtung.

lines.zh: 也為兩戶清寒家庭，辦妥完整的喪葬事宜。
lines.en: It also arranged complete funerals for two families in need.

lines.zh: 同年兩場觀音山捐血，共募得七百六十三袋熱血。
lines.en: Two blood drives at Guanyin Mountain that year gathered 763 bags.

lines.zh: 九月，在仁武慰問五區六百七十戶清寒家庭。
lines.en: In September, 670 low-income households in five districts received aid.

lines.zh: 十一月，九十四位清寒優秀學子領到獎助學金。
lines.en: In November, 94 bright students in need received scholarships.

lines.zh: 每月救急、每季關懷身障朋友，行善從不停歇。
lines.en: Monthly relief and quarterly visits to people with disabilities never stop.

lines.zh: 從七個人到上千位會員，善念一路擴散。
lines.en: From seven people to over a thousand members, kindness has spread.

lines.zh: 下一位伸出援手的，也許就是你。
lines.en: The next person to lend a hand could be you.

lines.zh: 高雄市堅山慈善會，邀您一起，讓愛延續。
lines.en: The Kaohsiung Jianshan Charity Association invites you to keep love going.
